Package dev.relism.flash.ext.webdav

Interface DavStorage

All Known Subinterfaces:
DavStorage.Properties, DavStorage.Writable
public interface DavStorage
What a DavHandler serves one request from: a tree of resources, rooted at the mount. A storage answers what a resource is and moves bytes; the handler speaks the protocol, keeps locks and counts the quota.

What a storage can do is in its type. One that only implements this interface is read-only; DavStorage.Writable adds writing, DavStorage.Properties keeps the properties clients set. Without Properties, the handler keeps them in memory.

The handler keys locks, the bytes in use and properties kept in memory by the storage's equals: two storages that show the same resources are equal. A record over its location gets this for free.
